resources.string: Forge AutoPhone lets the Forge OS AI agent interact with your phone — tapping, scrolling, typing, and launching apps — so it can complete tasks on your behalf.
AutoPhone needs Android Accessibility permission to read your screen and perform gestures. Tap below to open Settings, find Forge AutoPhone, and toggle it on.
AutoPhone binds to Forge OS (com.forge.os) so the agent can send it commands. Forge OS must be installed and have the External API enabled.
No schedules yet.\nTap + to create your first automation plan.
